title: DbHealthSummary
description: Stable read-surface wire shape mesh emits to console-ui for the Postgres/storage health panel. DISTINCT from mesh's internal map[string]any db-health rollup, which duplicates the pool map under both 'pools' and 'postgres_pools'. Ledger fix: this DTO CANONICALIZES onto a single typed 'pools' array, killing console-ui's 'postgres_pools || pools' OR-fallback. Per-pool entries are typed (pool_name/in_use/idle/...); tier+status stay OPEN strings. additionalProperties:false makes a re-introduced duplicate key a structural validation failure. The TypeScript interface in src/read-surface-db-health.ts is the paired source of truth.

status.description: Authority-resolved overall health status (ok/warning/unconfigured/...). OPEN string.

pools.description: The CANONICAL typed pool array. Single key — no postgres_pools duplicate.

issue_types.description: Issue type tags the rollup raised (e.g. db_fleet_pool_unreachable).
